leakage_policy.checked: source_record_id, exact text, normalized text; near-duplicate candidate review
leakage_policy.interpretation: No claim of document-level independence; sentence IDs identify individual sentences only.

future_acceptance_gate.missing_value_action: BLOCKED or UNKNOWN; do not synthesize
future_acceptance_gate.sentence_level_exception: May be assessed only under explicit sentence-level policy and must remain NOT_CHECKABLE at document level.
